title: 第二十三章 拜师石铄第二十四章 生死不知
lines: 第二十三章：拜师石铄
“炼药师？”，闻言，叶重一怔，随即眉头轻皱的失落道：“在元武大陆，只要是个人，谁不想成为炼药师。可炼药师，是随便什么人都能当上的么？那苛刻的条件，恐怕小子也不一定符合吧！而且我还只是刚刚成为一名武者罢了，等到晚辈突破到武宗了，一定麻烦前辈，看看小子有没有炼丹的天赋······”，话音忽然一顿，叶重猛的抬头，张大着嘴：“难道说，小子我达到了炼药师的要求？不可能啊！”。
非常欣赏叶重这幅震撼中略带一丝镇定又夹杂着期盼与狂喜的神色，石铄抚着胡子想了片刻，又上下打量了叶重一番，方才似乎有些为难的叹道：“虽然只是勉强够格，不过谁让我欠你人情呢？唉，罢了，就当是还你的人情债吧！如果不是小友，只怕老夫这一缕残魂，不日就要烟消云散了！”。
“前辈，不要寻晚辈的开心了。没成为武宗，怎么可能成为炼药师！”，叶重摇了摇摇头，却是不信的轻声道。
闻言，石铄却是一愣，随即略微发怒的沉声道：“老夫用得着骗你吗？你小子，难道刚刚在阴魔渊，没听清老夫说的话。只要你得到一种‘灵火’，你就可成为一名炼药师，你的灵魂天赋老夫可是亲自测试过，算是勉强合格了！”。
叶重一愣，随即低声自语道：“有可能那药曦并没有达到武宗之阶，只是因为‘灵火’和其绝佳的灵魂天赋之故，才成为一名二品炼药师的吧！”。
“药曦？你的梦中情人吗？看你这一副失魂落魄的怨妇样，该不会是被人抛弃了吧！”，石铄瞥了一眼略微失神的叶重，抚须取笑道。
无语的摇了摇头，叶重随即沉声问道：“前辈，就算以我的灵魂天赋，勉强合格可以成为一名炼药师，但这‘灵火’小子却是连听都没听说过，更不用说拥有了！”。
石铄鄙视的看了一眼叶重，随即轻笑道：“看来你小子的出生，并不怎么好嘛，连这‘灵火’都不知道。不过有老夫在，你还怕没有灵火吗？老夫就问你一句，你想不想成为一名炼药师，愿不愿意跟随老夫修习那炼药之术，好让老夫还了你的恩情，要知道我可是最不愿意欠别人人情的了！”。
斜瞥着一脸勉强的石铄，叶重的心中，总觉得这老家伙所说的勉强够格有点假，不过此时他也懒得深问。只是在欣喜之余，还有着几分怀疑：“前辈能让小子拥有灵火？”。
望着叶重那满是怀疑的小脸，石铄嘿嘿一笑，胸膛微微挺了起来，声音中，也是隐隐透出一股自傲：“那是当然，否则老夫用得着跟你废话吗？”。
眼睛一眨，叶重望向石铄的目光，顿时亮堂了起来，一脸热切的道：“那现在前辈可以赐小子一朵吗？好让小子我跟前辈修习那炼药之术！”。
“以前辈那强大的实力，肯定可以吧！那小子就多谢前辈了，并向前辈再次承诺，一定尽自己所力帮前辈重塑身躯！”，叶重舔了舔嘴唇，稚嫩的声音中多了一分客气，一丝热切，和严肃郑重的承诺。
看着一脸热切的叶重，石铄一愣，随即却是笑骂道：“你当‘灵火’是大白菜啊！老夫自己也不过只有一朵，难道要老夫将自己的给你啊！不过老夫知道哪里有灵火，并且可以帮你收服它！”。
“真的？”，叶重却是一脸不信的道。
“小子一句话，你究竟学不学吧！”，摇晃着脑袋，石铄却是忽然有点不耐的问道。
“学，学！”，叶重不再犹豫，小脑袋急忙点动，心中却是暗骂道：“敖煌，你好歹是条真龙，整天只知道打打杀杀，也不知道学学炼药之术。不过，你在阵法一道上的造诣，还是不错的。但是，你又何必再魂飞魄散前，自毁大部分自己的记忆，也不便宜我！”。
暗叹了一声，叶重心中却是默念道：“看来，你对于龙族还是心存善念的。不过，这样也好，否则我都不知道我是你敖煌，还是我自己叶重了！”。
“嘿嘿，愿意？愿意那就拜师吧。”，石铄随即在一块青石之上盘起了双腿，一脸奸诈的笑道。
“还要拜师么？”，叶重下意识的愣声道。
“废话，你不拜师便想让老夫对你倾囊相授？即使老夫欠你偌大的人情，但老夫也不会自贱到如此地步吧！你小子，做梦呢？”，石铄翻了翻白眼，显然，性子有些迂腐的老头，很是在乎这种师徒关系。毕竟没有这层关系，想让石铄倾囊相授，石铄自问是做不到。
并且，叶重说的没错。
在生面前，谁又想死呢？石铄自己的小命，可是全掌握在叶重手中了。只有加大自己与叶重二人之间的筹码，自己重塑肉身的希望才会大一分。

Chapter 23: Become a disciple of Shi Shuo
"Alchemist?" Hearing this, Ye Zhong was startled, and then he frowned slightly and said in disappointment: "In Yuanwu Continent, as long as it is an individual, who doesn't want to become an alchemist. But can anyone become an alchemist? I'm afraid that this kid may not meet the harsh conditions! And I'm just a newbie. I have just become a warrior. When the younger generation breaks through to the Martial Sect, I will definitely trouble the seniors to see if I have the talent for alchemy..." Ye Zhong suddenly paused and raised his head, mouth wide open: "Do you think I have met the requirements of an alchemist? It's impossible!"
Really admiring Ye Zhong's shocked expression that was slightly calm and mixed with expectation and ecstasy, Shi Shuo stroked his beard and thought for a moment, then looked Ye Zhong up and down, and then he seemed to sigh in embarrassment: "Although it's just barely qualified, who told me to owe you a favor? Oh, that's it, just think of it as repaying your debt of favor! If it weren't for my little friend, I'm afraid this residual soul of me will disappear in a day!"
"Senior, don't seek pleasure from the younger generation. How can you become an alchemist without becoming a martial arts master!" Ye Zhong shook his head, but whispered in disbelief.
Hearing this, Shi Shuo was stunned for a moment, and then said in a low and slightly angry voice: "Do I need to lie to you? You kid, did you not hear clearly what I said in the Yin Demon Abyss just now? As long as you get a kind of 'spiritual fire', you can become an alchemist. I have personally tested your soul talent, and you are barely qualified!"
Ye Zhong was stunned for a moment, then whispered to himself: "It's possible that Yao Xi didn't reach the level of Wuzong, but only became a second-grade alchemist because of the 'Spiritual Fire' and his excellent soul talent!".
"Yao Xi? Is this the lover of your dreams? Looking at you like a lost and resentful woman, you must have been abandoned by someone, right?" Shi Shuo glanced at Ye Zhong, who was slightly absent-minded, and teased while stroking his beard.
Shaking his head speechlessly, Ye Zhong then asked in a deep voice: "Senior, even if I am barely qualified to become an alchemist with my soul talent, I have never even heard of this 'Spiritual Fire' kid, let alone possess it!"
Shi Shuo glanced at Ye Zhong with disdain, and then chuckled: "It seems that your kid's birth was not very good, and he didn't even know about this 'spiritual fire'. But with me here, are you still afraid of not having the spiritual fire? I just want to ask you, do you want to become an alchemist, and are you willing to follow me to practice the art of alchemy, so that I can repay your kindness? You know, I am the last person who wants to owe others a favor!"
Glancing sideways at Shi Shuo, who had a reluctant expression, Ye Zhong always felt that what the old guy said was barely qualified was a bit false, but at this time he was too lazy to ask further. Although he was overjoyed, he still had some doubts: "Senior, can the boy have spiritual fire?"
Looking at Ye Zhong's doubtful little face, Shi Shuo chuckled, his chest puffed up slightly, and there was a hint of pride in his voice: "Of course, otherwise I would have no need to talk nonsense to you?".
With a blink of an eye, Ye Zhong looked at Shi Shuo and his eyes suddenly brightened up. He said with an eager expression: "Now, can senior give me one? So that senior and I can practice the art of refining medicine!".
"With senior's strong strength, it must be possible! The boy would like to thank senior and promise again that he will do his best to help senior reshape his body!" Ye Zhong licked his lips, and there was a hint of politeness, a hint of enthusiasm, and a serious and solemn promise in his childish voice.
Looking at the eager Ye Zhong, Shi Shuo was stunned, but then he laughed and scolded: "You think the 'spiritual fire' is a cabbage! I only have one myself, why should I give you my own! But I know where the spiritual fire is, and I can help you conquer it!".
"Really?" Ye Zhong said with a look of disbelief.
"Young man, what are you saying? Will you learn it or not?" Shaking his head, Shi Shuo asked suddenly impatiently.
"Learn, learn!", Ye Zhong no longer hesitated, his little head moved hurriedly, but he cursed secretly in his heart: "Ao Huang, you are a real dragon after all. You only know how to fight and kill all day long, and you don't know how to learn alchemy. However, your attainments in formations are still good. But, why do you destroy most of your own memories before you are gone? It's not easy for me!"
Sighing secretly, Ye Chong thought silently in his heart: "It seems that you still have good thoughts towards the Dragon Clan. But that's okay, otherwise I wouldn't know whether I am you, Ao Huang, or myself, Ye Chong!".
"Hey, are you willing? If you are willing, then I can become a disciple." Shi Shuo then crossed his legs on a piece of bluestone and said with a sly smile.
"Do you still want to become a disciple?" Ye Zhong said subconsciously.
"Nonsense, you want me to teach you everything you have without becoming a disciple? Even if I owe you a huge favor, I won't despise myself to such an extent! You kid, what are you dreaming about?" Shi Shuo rolled his eyes. Obviously, the old man with a somewhat pedantic temperament cares about this master-disciple relationship. After all, without this kind of relationship, Shi Shuo asked himself that he couldn't do it if he wanted Shi Shuo to teach him everything he could.
Moreover, Ye Chong was right.
In the face of life, who wants to die? Shi Shuo's own life was entirely in Ye Zhong's hands. Only by increasing the stakes between himself and Ye Zhong can his hope of rebuilding his body be greater.
title_en: Chapter 23 Become a disciple of Shi Shuo Chapter 24 I don’t know whether I will live or die
